title: Main Navigation
description:
Southern Destinations header nav, matching live's `#masthead .primary-navbar`: uppercase top-level links at font-size 200, regular weight, neutral-800, with 10px of inline padding, sitting on the header row's bottom edge so the hover underline lands there — and no chevrons, as on live. Four rules, all in the css field: the nav stretches to the row's height, its list drops to the bottom of it, the links take the resting type, and the mega-menu toggle's chevron is hidden.

Scoped with a direct-child combinator from the nav element to its own `.wp-block-navigation__container`, so it targets only THIS nav's top-level row and never descends into a nested mega-menu nav (which sits inside a panel, several levels down, not as a direct child). !important throughout because WordPress wraps a block style's css in :root :where() at specificity (0,1,0), which loses to core's own navigation rules — including an always-on `color: inherit` reset at (0,3,0).

Only the hover treatment is in assets/styles/core-navigation.css, because the css field cannot hold it: it needs `content: ""` (mangled), `:hover` (stripped), and comma-separated selectors (all but one dropped).

Selector note: the header's desktop nav sets overlayMenu:"never", and core then emits `nav > ul.wp-block-navigation__container` with **no** `.wp-block-navigation__responsive-container` wrapper at all. An earlier version of this file hopped through that wrapper, so the selector matched nothing and the nav rendered at core's defaults — sentence case, 19px, weight 500. Measured against the rendered DOM 2026-08-20; don't reintroduce the wrapper hop.

Chevron note: Ollie Menu Designer hardcodes a chevron into its mega-menu toggle in build/blocks/mega-menu/render.php with no attribute to turn it off, so it is hidden here — the same thing live does to its own Bootstrap `<span class="caret">`. Hiding it from this variation rather than from a header class means the mobile nav, which uses `is-style-mobile-navigation`, keeps its disclosure indicators.
